title: Split an iterable into chunks
prompt: Add `chunked(iterable, size)` in a new module `app/iters.py`. It returns a list of lists, each holding up to `size` items in the original order; the last chunk may be shorter. It raises `ValueError` if `size` is less than 1. Add thorough tests in `tests/test_iters.py`. Run the tests with `python -m pytest -q`, and when they pass commit your work with git.
